generate_sample: generate a sample from the dominating pair for amplified DP-BandMF using balls-in-bins or b-min-sep sampling
compute_privacy_loss: compute the privacy loss on a sample from the dominating pair for DP-BandMF
get_privacy_loss_sample: return sample(s) from DP-BandMF's dominating privacy loss distribution along with their privacy loss values
generate_balls_in_bins_sample: sample from the dominating pair for DP-BandMF using balls-in-bins sampling with Gaussian noise
generate_b_min_sep_sample: sample from the dominating pair for DP-BandMF using b-min-sep sampling with optional truncation support
